config.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.

benchmark.ceiling_definition: pocket identity with zero retained profit and zero profit split, taken on the no-withdrawal path. That path bounds survival, because a withdrawal only ever lowers a balance, but it does not bound earnings: trades an early death avoids can be losing ones
benchmark.neutrality_test: per-account fingerprint of trade count, booked gross and commission, and killing trade; not equality of totals

design.terminal: one firm-permitted request, voluntary cushion released
design.selection: in-sample; local refinement around each family/objective coarse winner
